scientific_integrity: The pointwise identity is proved by direct algebra from the primal packing set and Rogers threshold dual certificate. The expectation step uses only the BRS threshold equation and marginal absolute continuity. The bundled exact-rational program is a regression check, not a substitute for the proof. Originality remains subject to the possibility of an older equivalent complementary-slackness formulation under different terminology.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives an exact decomposition of the slack in the standard BRS threshold dual certificate. It does not bound the threshold-mismatch expectation using only marginal information and does not classify which dependent marginal families can realize the constant truncated sum required for equality.
title: Exact defect decomposition for the Bruss–Robertson–Steele inequality
